title: Limited acquisition and quality check of public SOXL daily OHLC / splits / cash-distribution dates for 2021-03-03..2024-09-30
model_assignment: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (per docs/tasks/HISTORICAL_DAILY_DATA_SONNET55_REQUEST.md); actual serving model not independently verifiable from inside the run
prior_attempts_not_repeated: research/after_tax_comparability_20261027/data_candidates/attempts.json @ 737ef35: Yahoo chart API, Stooq, Nasdaq dividend API, Direxion product page via curl all returned CONNECT 403 from the egress proxy (environment policy). The same curl/host combinations are not repeated.
target_window: 2021-03-03..2024-09-30 (conditional candidate: day after the last known split 2021-03-02). Not an unused OOS: results over this window were already seen elsewhere in the project.
wanted: SOXL daily Open/High/Low/Close/Volume, trading dates, price unit; NOT dividend-adjusted; state split-adjusted vs as-traded or mark UNVERIFIED
split dates / direction / ratio; confirm no split inside the window
cash distributions: unrounded amount, ex-date, record-date, pay-date; issuer primary source preferred; missing quarters never filled with 0
F&G provenance of the stored CSV and the 2021-02 integer-to-decimal change: report UNVERIFIED if not explained; history stays a proxy without as-of proof
historical fee history vs fixed Rakuten fee scenario: NOT decided here (principal design item)

budget.attempt_definition: one outbound read request for one URL, successful or not (a read of a page that is already in the conversation, a local file or a GitHub MCP read of this repository is not an attempt)
budget.provider_definition: one distinct site/organisation not used in the 737ef35 attempts

rules: Only read paths already available to this session (no new API registration / key / contract / billing / account connection; no network, allowed-host or cloud-environment change)
Do not repeat an environment denial; record it and stop that path. No denial circumvention (no spoofed headers, no mirror hunting to bypass a block, no URL brute force, no site crawling)
Subscription / authentication / access-denied pages stop that provider
Search snippets are never described as a full-period CSV

Raw data goes to data_candidates/ with URL, retrieval time, applicable period, columns, adjustment definition, unit, SHA256 and licence-redistribution status; if redistribution is not allowed, save only the location and a verifiable summary
No reconstruction of Open from Adj Close; no pay-date guessing; no gap filling

Checks: duplicate dates, finite positive prices, OHLC consistency (low<=open,close<=high), missing dates vs the stored trading calendar, window boundaries, out-of-range coverage, event units. If no calendar cross-check is possible, missing vs holiday is not asserted
The 2026-07-01 Open one-cent mismatch (stored 237.79 vs public 237.78 in the principal spot check) is recorded as a mismatch and not silently unified
Not adopted into the fixed 48-cell input; no threshold / ratio / partial sale / start / end comparisons

status_vocabulary.DATA_READY: OHLC, split, and distribution pay-date items all present and definitions verified for the interval (F&G is a separate flag: history proxy, as-of unknown)
status_vocabulary.UNAVAILABLE_IN_THIS_ENV: not obtainable by the permitted paths in this environment; not evidence that the data does not exist

stop_condition: when availability of each item is determined, or the attempt/provider budget is spent, or all permitted paths are denied; report target SHA, counts obtained, missing items and attempts used
